game: Comic Jumper: The Adventures of Captain Smiley
approach: Static recompilation with ReXGlue, sharing engine fixes with the 'Splosion Man recomp (same Twisted Pixel engine)
notes: Boots to gameplay and is playable through the first levels on Linux (Vulkan, tested on RADV). Full game unlocked, options menu with FSR/CAS upscaling and frame limit matching the display, achievements page, Qt launcher and AppImage. Needs your own copy of the XBLA game. Internal resolution 2x is GPU-heavy in the hub.
